required_scenarios.name: capacity_rollover
required_scenarios.intent: Non-protected work rolls forward when today's realistic capacity is full.

required_scenarios.name: protected_overload_warning
required_scenarios.intent: Protected high-value work is not silently dropped even when it overloads the day.

required_scenarios.name: low_energy_lightens_plan
required_scenarios.intent: Low energy narrows the main sequence and keeps the day executable.

required_scenarios.name: high_energy_deep_fit_no_expansion
required_scenarios.intent: High energy can favor deep work without expanding capacity beyond the user's day.

required_scenarios.name: dependency_chain_protection
required_scenarios.intent: Prerequisite work is protected before dependent tasks.

required_scenarios.name: user_priority_adjustment_protection
required_scenarios.intent: User corrections remain visible and can override the default planner shape.

required_scenarios.name: behavior_feedback_penalizes_interruptions
required_scenarios.intent: Repeated interruptions reduce a task's fit for immediate execution.

required_scenarios.name: multi_goal_competition_protects_high_value_goal
required_scenarios.intent: High-value goals are protected from lower-value but noisy work.

required_scenarios.name: overdue_goal_recovery_promotes_next_task
required_scenarios.intent: Overdue goals pull their next executable task back into Today's protected sequence.

regression_rules.reason: The evaluator itself failed or reported failed scenarios.
A protected product behavior lost coverage.
Strategy Detail and offline comparison would lose explainability.

changed_rules.reason: A new evaluator version needs an explicit baseline policy.
New quality coverage should become part of the golden baseline.
